what_is_it.description: What this company or product is, in one sentence, from the first screen only.

who_is_it_for.description: Who it is for, from the first screen only. Say "unclear" if it does not say.

what_to_do_next.description: The one action the page wants the visitor to take, and the button that asks for it. Say "unclear" if there is none.

mobile_differs.description: Anything the mobile first screen loses or hides compared with desktop. Empty string if nothing.

notes.description: One or two sentences on the first impression: does it look credible and current?
